integrity: The proof is finite and symbolic. It derives the exact support function of the finite weak-\(\ell_p\) unit ball by rearrangement, uses an explicit equality vector for necessity, and checks disjointness directly on coordinate supports. Finite random tests were used only as a stress check and are not part of the proof.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies only codimension-one graph embeddings whose first \(m\) coordinates are the identity. It does not classify arbitrary finite-dimensional weak-\(\ell_p\) isometries, nonlinear isometries, or noncommutative analogues.
title: Sharp graph embeddings of finite weak \(\ell_p\) spaces
